# Outsource MedClaim

> Outsource MedClaim is a U.S.-based medical billing and revenue cycle management (RCM) company. We provide outsourced medical billing, CPT/ICD-10 coding, denial management, accounts receivable follow-up, credentialing, and patient billing for independent practices, specialty groups, and health systems across all 50 states.

Key facts:
- AAPC and AHIMA certified coders and billers
- 98.5%+ first-pass clean claim rate, denial rates reduced to 4% or below
- EHR/PM integrations include Epic, athenahealth, Meditech, eClinicalWorks, AdvancedMD, Kareo, Cerner, NextGen, and most custom systems
- HIPAA compliant; Business Associate Agreement (BAA) executed with every client
- Percentage-of-collections, flat-rate, offshore hybrid, and custom enterprise pricing models

## Specialty Billing Services

- [Infusion Billing Services](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/infusion-billing-services): Outsource infusion billing services to reduce costs, improve claim accuracy, and accelerate reimbursements. Expert support for coding, claims, and denial management.
- [Laboratory Medical Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/laboratory-medical-billing): Get cleaner claims, faster reimbursements, and full-cycle RCM with Outsource Laboratory Medical Billing for high-volume diagnostic, pathology, and molecular labs.
- [Optometry Billing Services](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/optometry-billing-services): Increase collections and simplify RCM with Outsource Optometry Billing Services tailored for independent optometrists and multi-location eye care clinics.
- [Pediatric Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/pediatric-billing): Improve cash flow and reduce claim denials with pediatric billing. Accurate coding, faster reimbursements, and revenue cycle support.
- [Psychiatric Billing Services](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/psychiatric-billing-services): Outsource psychiatric billing services to improve claim accuracy, reduce denials, and maximize reimbursements. Expert billing support for mental health practices.
- [Wound Care Billing](https://outsourcemedicalbillingservices.us/wound-care-billing): Reduce administrative load and maximize revenue with Outsource Wound Care Billing. Coding, claims submission, denial management, and payer follow-up.
